business: mon-restaurant.eu (all-in-one online bookings, ordering, floor plan and website for restaurants, sold as a monthly subscription)
target: Owners of independent, already-trading restaurants in French-speaking Belgium (Brussels and Wallonia) who decide on their own tools

segments.name: Small family bistro or brasserie (under 40 seats, owner in the kitchen or on the floor; 'income' is the owner's own yearly take-home in euros)
Mid-size restaurant (40 to 90 seats, a team of 5 to 15; 'income' is the owner's own yearly take-home in euros)
Pizzeria, Asian or snack restaurant with a lot of takeaway and delivery ('income' is the owner's own yearly take-home in euros)
Upscale or gastronomic restaurant ('income' is the owner's own yearly take-home in euros)

behaviours.name: Phone and paper book
behaviours.how: Takes every booking by phone in a paper book, no online booking at all, and has managed like this for years.

behaviours.name: Already on Zenchef / Resengo / Tablebooker
behaviours.how: Pays every month for a booking tool, is used to it, and its reminders already cut some no-shows.

behaviours.name: Depends on Uber Eats / Deliveroo / Takeaway
behaviours.how: Gets a real share of sales from delivery apps, hates the commission, but the apps bring the customers.

behaviours.name: Tied to a POS
behaviours.how: Has a Lightspeed or similar till, with contract and hardware, and wants anything new to work with it.

behaviours.name: Cash-tight and cautious
behaviours.how: Watches every monthly charge after hard years, cuts subscriptions first, needs proof before paying.

behaviours.name: Asks other restaurant owners
behaviours.how: Only adopts a tool a colleague or supplier recommends, distrusts sales calls and new start-ups.

behaviours.name: Wants to modernise
behaviours.how: Is actively looking to get the restaurant online properly and compares tools.

objections: I have no time to set up a new system, and my staff will not learn it
My customers book by phone; they will not book online
If I ask for a deposit, my Belgian customers will go elsewhere
Delivery apps bring me customers; my own site will not
Who are you? I have never heard of you and see no restaurant using it
What if it breaks in the middle of Saturday service?
197 euros a month is a lot for my margins
I already pay for Zenchef / my till; I do not want to switch everything
habits: you answer the phone yourself between two dishes during service
you had two tables no-show last month
you work six days a week and do the admin on Monday
a supplier rep visits you every week
your nephew made your website years ago and it is out of date
your Google rating matters to you and you read the new reviews
